\mathcal I_{73}\coloneqq\{1,\ldots,395\},\qquad

\{(f_i,\{f_j:j\in D_i\}):i\in\mathcal I_{73}\},\qquad

\mathcal E_{73}\coloneqq\{(f_i,f_j):i\in\mathcal I_{73}\land j\in D_i\}.
